answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 297 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, because the declared depth is published in the violet receipt and checked against the nectar nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the nebula audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
